primary_objectives: Locate the last remaining Kleine Blume warheads — London believes they were moved by rail to the Vallée des Dieux vineyard, which may once have been a V1 launch site.
Tasks: locate the underground facility → gain access → search it → destroy the Zugwerfer Carriage.

How: in the facility, open the Control Room with the Control Room Key (or a Satchel Charge) and pull the switch. Follow the marker to the Zugwerfer Carriage, plant a Satchel Charge and light the fuse.
optional_objectives: Eliminate the Elite Snipers — an elite sniper unit guards the vineyard. Neutralize Elite Snipers (3).
Destroy the V1 Launch Site — sabotage the V1 and sabotage the ramp (2), then leave the area before it blows.
